recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing QuestionnaireResponse part of the published FHIR-32523 decision without broadening into unrelated linkId families; any MeasureReport symmetry question should be handled separately by CQI.
issue_request: FHIR-32523 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It requested limiting linkId length, including QuestionnaireResponse, and the accepted resolution was a best-practice warning that linkId should be under 256 characters and avoid whitespace characters.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 5ffa1f49eb, which added the best-practice length warning only to Questionnaire.item.linkId. Current Questionnaire source already has the que-15 warning; current QuestionnaireResponse source had only the later qrs-3 whitespace constraint and was missing the length warning.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse as active resources. FHIR-46191 later applied whitespace restrictions to both Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse, so this reconciliation only needed the missing length warning. FHIR-38832 introduced analogous Measure/MeasureReport linkIds in a separate CQI resource family and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Added qrs-5 on QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId with the elementdefinition-bestpractice warning, human text matching Questionnaire, expression $this.length() <= 255, and source QuestionnaireResponse. Added qrs-5.f1.fail.xml with a 256-character linkId to exercise the warning.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: added qrs-5 best-practice warning and condition to QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId.
source/questionnaireresponse/invariant-tests/qrs-5.f1.fail.xml: added an invariant-test fixture with a 256-character linkId.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue added whitespace regex constraints to both Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse linkId elements, satisfying the whitespace portion of FHIR-32523 in current source.
Introduced Measure/MeasureReport linkId elements after FHIR-32523; useful for scope checking but a separate CQI issue family.
